entries.title: Infinitary on iPhone and iPad speaks your language
entries.body: Infinitary on iPhone and iPad now speaks the same languages as on your Mac: Arabic, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), English, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese (Brazil) and Spanish. It follows your phone's language, and Settings → Appearance → Language opens Infinitary's page in iOS Settings to choose another. In Arabic the app reads right to left. Your crew still writes in your Mac's language.

picture.alt: Settings → Appearance on iPhone in Arabic, laid out right to left: the theme choice, then the Language heading, a line saying it is set on Infinitary's page in iOS Settings, and a row naming Arabic with its arrow pointing left.
